entries.condition: the closing comment of a drafted YARA rule that leaves any value the sample stores (code_constants) out of its stored group: how many, and in parentheses why where a test its answer's own figures decide (a seed fewer than two results state, a hash whose algorithm's matches chance explains) or the group left some out; the analyst report's line for the rule reads its count and its reason back from that comment (stored_left_out), so a stored report says what its stored draft did
basis: report code_constants (each value read with a 32-bit value)
the values the draft's stored group holds (StoredSelection.used)
the tests code_constants.held applies and the group's condition (a held seed and two held hashes)
